title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode5 Conflict

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I had a feeling it was you, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi... What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I just got out of a meeting.
I was just about to head back to the office.
You?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I also had a meeting...
For a show that my group is going to appear in.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting to run into him here...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Calm down. Don't let your emotions get the best of you.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Any conversation can be interpreted a thousand different ways. Including the one I overheard just now...)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: There's also that scary rumor about Mr. Hiiragi. I hope it's not true, but it's probably best not to rock the boat.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to corroborate what I just heard.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you mind if I asked you a quick question, Mr. Hiiragi?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
No, I don't mind...
But you seem to be taking an awfully formal tone for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, the thing is... I know this isn't something I should ask someone directly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Withholding information is understandable...
But I can't see you outright lying to me, Mr. Hiiragi. At least, that's what I'd like to believe.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What is it that you wish to ask?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just overheard some of the staff talking about a certain rumor surrounding you, Mr. Hiiragi...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: A rumor?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes. I don't know the details...
But they said they didn't want to “rock the boat” by not choosing ReLight for their shows. That was the gist of it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you happen to know what they were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I see...
I do agree that you shouldn't ask people that sort of question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know I'm stepping out of bounds here.
But if I did misunderstand...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: No, I know what they're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That being said, all I've been doing is telling people that I want to work with people who believe in ReLight's potential.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Nothing more, nothing less.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In ReLight's potential...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Since Idol Lovers, ReLight has gained a lot of traction.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Now is our chance to go even higher.
Which is why I am adamant about working with those who genuinely believe in their potential.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “I won't work with anyone who believes otherwise.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, a few people interpreted it that way, which turned into a rumor?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That seems plausible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still don't entirely know what his full intentions were... But at the very least, I don't think he's lying about any of this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(All the people I spoke with...
They were probably acting strange because they'd gotten wind of that rumor.)

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I still do believe that MORE MORE JUMP! is a great group with a lot of growth potential...

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: However, if we're thinking about long-term stability, then ReLight is the correct way to go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That wasn't the sole cause of us not receiving any offers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (ReLight was just that much better than us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which is why we weren't chosen.)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Are we done here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...
I have my answer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I know what my group needs to do next.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What your group needs to do next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We need to become better than ever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We need to become idols that can spread hope to others more than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Idols that can spread hope to others more than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Tell me, Kiritani. What is your idea of an idol that can spread hope to others?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think that's someone who can cheer people up and brighten up their—

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That's not enough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It isn't...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: An idol is a light.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
A light that can never go out.
A bright beacon of hope that has a duty to stay illuminated for the sake of their fans.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: At no point can they go out and leave everybody wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Even if it does go out and manages to glow once more...
There's no guarantee that it will keep shining forever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He's right...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I... That time... I gave up...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I made my fans so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But... Even so...!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I genuinely believe that ReLight will never go out.
As idols, they will spread more hope to others than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A light that never goes out...)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Our groups have the same goal in mind...
So, we'll likely be seeing quite a lot of each other in the future.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I won't discount your group's work ethic and determination.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
But know this.
We refuse to let you take the lead.

There's no guarantee that it will keep shining forever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was totally lost for words...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi's absolutely right.)

rows.Line: (I burned out as an idol once, and now I...)
